description: This file implements a MiniLang method operation called StringAppend, which performs string concatenation with optional prefix and suffix, formatting arguments, and extends a base class for method operations in OFBiz's MiniLang framework.

classes.name: StringAppend
classes.description: Implements a MiniLang operation that appends a formatted string with optional prefix and suffix to a field, based on XML configuration.

classes.name: StringAppendFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating StringAppend instances from XML elements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Performs the string append operation, format the string with arguments, and updates the target field.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of this StringAppend instance.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate StringAppend from XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation, 'string-append'.
